subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Profit
solution: The correct answer is: **Expense**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Expense **refers to the money spent on something. (किसी चीज़ पर खर्च किया गया पैसा) • **Example**: *Monthly bills and rent payments are examples of regular household expenses.* • **Profit **is the money earned from something. (किसी चीज़ से कमाया गया धन) • **Example**: *After successful sales, the company experienced a significant profit increase in the last quarter.* • These two words are opposite in meaning. • So, the antonym for Profit is Expense. Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Earnings**: Income generated. (आय उत्पन्न हुई) • **Amount**: Quantifiable value. (मात्रात्मक मूल्य) • **Sale**: Transaction involving the exchange of goods or services for money. (पैसे के बदले वस्तुओं या सेवाओं के आदान-प्रदान से जुड़ा लेनदेन) 40:T72e, The correct answer is: **Someone called off the meeting**.
